placements.name: Clark Fork Trailhead (alternate, 0.5 km away, near road end)

otherFacts.value: Clark Fork Road (7N83), left off Hwy 108 about 2.5 mi before Dardanelles; ~9 mi to trailhead

notes: Strong page ID (two climber.org reports). The 2007 report calls the same start Iceberg Meadow TH; USFS lists Disaster Creek TH and Clark Fork TH ~0.5 km apart, both on Clark Fork Road.
